title: Beginner
description: Introduce yourself, talk about routines and handle simple everyday exchanges.

nodes.title: The Verb “To Be”
nodes.summary: am / is / are in statements, negatives and questions.

objectives.text: Use am, is and are in affirmative sentences
Make negative sentences with am not, isn't and aren't
Ask and answer yes/no questions with to be

id.title: Kata Kerja “To Be”
id.summary: am / is / are dalam kalimat positif, negatif dan pertanyaan.

objectives.be-affirmative: Menggunakan am, is dan are dalam kalimat positif
objectives.be-negative: Membuat kalimat negatif dengan am not, isn't dan aren't
objectives.be-questions: Bertanya dan menjawab pertanyaan ya/tidak dengan to be

nodes.title: Simple Present Tense
nodes.summary: Talk about habits, facts and daily routines.

objectives.text: Form basic affirmative sentences (including he/she/it + -s)
Form basic negative sentences with don't / doesn't
Ask and answer simple present questions with do / does
Describe daily routines

id.title: Simple Present Tense
id.summary: Membicarakan kebiasaan, fakta dan rutinitas harian.

objectives.negative: Membentuk kalimat negatif dasar dengan don't / doesn't
objectives.questions: Bertanya dan menjawab pertanyaan simple present dengan do / does

nodes.title: Asking Questions
nodes.summary: What, where, who, when, how — plus yes/no questions.

objectives.text: Choose the right question word (what, where, who, when, how)
Put words in the right order in questions
Ask for and give basic personal information

id.title: Bertanya
id.summary: What, where, who, when, how — plus pertanyaan ya/tidak.

objectives.wh-words: Memilih kata tanya yang tepat (what, where, who, when, how)
objectives.question-order: Menyusun kata dengan urutan yang benar dalam pertanyaan
objectives.personal-info: Menanyakan dan memberikan informasi pribadi dasar

nodes.title: Introducing Yourself
nodes.summary: Name, origin, job and interests in a few sentences.

objectives.text: Introduce yourself with name, origin and job
Talk about your likes and interests
Respond when someone introduces themselves

id.title: Memperkenalkan Diri
id.summary: Nama, asal, pekerjaan dan minat dalam beberapa kalimat.

objectives.introduce-yourself-with: Memperkenalkan diri dengan nama, asal dan pekerjaan
objectives.talk-about-your: Membicarakan hal yang disukai dan minat

nodes.title: Daily Routines
nodes.summary: Describe your day with time expressions.

objectives.text: Describe a typical day in order
Use time expressions like at 7, in the morning, every day

objectives.use-time-expressions: Menggunakan keterangan waktu seperti at 7, in the morning, every day

nodes.title: There Is / There Are
nodes.summary: Describe places and what they contain.

objectives.text: Describe a room or place with there is / there are
Ask questions with is there / are there

objectives.describe-a-room: Mendeskripsikan ruangan atau tempat dengan there is / there are
objectives.ask-questions-with: Bertanya dengan is there / are there

nodes.title: Present Continuous
nodes.summary: Talk about what is happening now.

objectives.text: Form present continuous sentences
Contrast now with routines

id.title: Present Continuous
id.summary: Membicarakan apa yang sedang terjadi sekarang.

nodes.title: Can for Ability
nodes.summary: Say what you can and can't do.

objectives.text: Talk about abilities with can / can't
Ask polite requests with can

id.title: Can untuk Kemampuan
id.summary: Katakan apa yang bisa dan tidak bisa kamu lakukan.

nodes.title: Everyday Conversation
nodes.summary: Short exchanges in shops, cafés and the street.

objectives.text: Order food and drinks
Ask for prices and directions
Keep a short conversation going

id.title: Percakapan Sehari-hari
id.summary: Percakapan singkat di toko, kafe dan jalan.

id.title: Pemula
id.description: Memperkenalkan diri, membicarakan rutinitas, dan menangani percakapan sehari-hari yang sederhana.
